title: Inside the Twilight

actors.name: Condenna the Pitiless
actors.greeting: Show your sponsor papers. This camp has no patience for an uncertain recruit.

actors.name: Instructor Cargall
actors.source_identity_audit: Native human instructor recreation; source race remains unverified.
actors.greeting: Preserve what the cult can still use. Those who falter will learn the cost.

actors.name: Instructor Mylva
actors.greeting: Your body, your mind and your words must all serve the flame.

actors.name: Instructor Devoran
actors.greeting: A hound needs a handler who can earn its trust. Gromm'ko thinks his raptor has no equal.

actors.name: Commander Jarod Shadowsong
actors.greeting: The others still need us. Show Dezco what Ortell recovered, and keep moving.

actors.name: Sunwalker Dezco
actors.greeting: Jarod sends a trusted traveler. Let me see his letter; the Dawnchasers will follow these buyers.

actors.name: Twilight Recruit
actors.greeting: The watch captain sent me here. Is this about my papers?

actors.name: Immolated Supplicant
actors.greeting: The fire will not let me go. Use the binding gem before it consumes me.

actors.name: Immolated Supplicant
actors.greeting: I can still serve. Please, do not leave me to burn.

actors.name: Immolated Supplicant
actors.greeting: Cargall said the gem would hold the flame. You have it, do you not?

actors.name: Training Core Hound
actors.greeting: The hound watches your hands and sniffs toward the feeding station.

actors.name: Orb of Ascension
actors.greeting: The orb brightens. A voice tests your certainty before the flame.

actors.name: Twilight Initiate
actors.greeting: The congregation waits for its speaker. Read their mood before you answer.

actors.name: Immolated Supplicant
actors.greeting: Cargall said the gem would hold the flame. You have it, do you not?

quests.title: Signed in Blood
quests.objectives: Speak to a Twilight Recruit at the road checkpoint, lure him into cover, and use the blackjack to take his papers.
quests.description: A small recruit group uses the eastern road checkpoint, away from Jarod's ritual camp. Speak to one recruit and convince him that an instructor is waiting in the hollow. Follow him there, then use the blackjack. His signed recruitment papers will let me forge an identity that gets you past the instructors.
quests.completion: His sponsor has already signed. I can change the bearer's name and leave the seal intact. Now we have a way into the cult, rather than another excuse to run at the altar.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Elementalist Ortell at the expedition refuge.

quests.title: Your New Identity
quests.objectives: Present the altered papers to Condenna and pass the identity check.
quests.description: These forged papers give you a recruit's identity. Present them to Condenna at the recruiting compound. Once you are admitted, find my concealed contact at the outhouse just outside the western edge of the training grounds. Bring intelligence and reports there so you can remain inside the cult.
quests.completion: The seal is in order. Remember whose banner shelters you, recruit. Your first trial begins with fire.
quests.request_text: Your sponsor's seal, recruit. Show it to me.
quests.return_text: Speak with Condenna the Pitiless at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Trial By Fire
quests.objectives: Defeat 8 trial fire elementals while the disguise is active.
quests.description: Our new recruits must face the fire. Speak to Condenna to begin or resume your trial, then defeat eight Trial Fire Elementals while wearing your disguise. They will be called one at a time. This trial tests your nerve, not your loyalties. Renew your cover with Ortell or your papers if needed.
quests.completion: The flame has tested you and found you standing. Do not mistake that for mastery.
quests.request_text: Eight flames, eight victories. Have you finished your trial?
quests.return_text: Speak with Condenna the Pitiless at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: In Bloom
quests.objectives: Gather 5 Flame Blossoms from the proving grounds. Avoid Smolderos.
quests.description: Flame blossoms grow in the proving fields southeast of our camp. Bring back five. Smolderos prowls those fields and the fiery instructors use them for trials, so pay attention to the ground around you.
quests.completion: Good. These blossoms will feed the brazier. Cargall will decide whether you are useful beyond gathering fuel.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Condenna the Pitiless at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Waste of Flesh
quests.objectives: Use the Frostgale Crystal to extinguish the flames on four immolated supplicants.
quests.description: Ask Cargall to prepare the trial, then use the supplied crystal on the four burning recruits in the training yard. They will not survive long. Saved recruits remain recorded if the attempt is interrupted; Cargall can prepare the remaining recruits and replace a lost crystal.
quests.completion: All three survived. The cult wastes nothing that can still serve. You may continue.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Cargall at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Twilight Training
quests.objectives: Report completion of all three admission trials and meet the two instructors.
quests.description: You have passed the first trials. Visit Instructor Mylva and Instructor Devoran and ask each for an introduction to their training. Return to Condenna when both have acknowledged you.
quests.completion: Both instructors have accepted you. Attend to their trials; an initiate must be ready in body and mind.
quests.request_text: Have both Mylva and Devoran accepted you?
quests.return_text: Speak with Condenna the Pitiless at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Physical Training: Forced Labor
quests.objectives: Use the Twilight Pick to break 5 Darkwhisper Lodestones in the training gorge.
quests.description: Take this pick out into the gorge and break five lodestone deposits. The work is the test; there is no ore to carry back. The deposits follow a loop south and west of the training compound. Use the pick on a deposit after clearing any trouble around it. I can replace a lost pick.
quests.completion: Five loads, delivered without excuse. Strength is only useful when it obeys.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Mylva at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Agility Training: Run Like Hell!
quests.objectives: Stay alive and keep away from the Blazing Trainer for one minute inside the training grounds.
quests.description: Ask me to summon your Blazing Trainer. Run away for one minute without leaving the training grounds. He is slower than a running recruit, but standing still will hurt. You must remain alive, on foot and disguised.
quests.completion: You reached every station in time. Keep that speed when the ground is less forgiving.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Mylva at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Mental Training: Speaking the Truth to Power
quests.objectives: Answer 10 orb questions correctly near Mylva; each offered question allows five seconds.
quests.description: Use the Orb of Ascension near Mylva. Speak to your questioner and answer ten simple questions correctly. You have five seconds per offered question. Wrong or late answers interrupt the attempt; answers already credited remain recorded. Use the orb again to retry.
quests.completion: Ten answers under pressure. A wandering mind has no place at the altar.
quests.request_text: Ten correct answers under pressure. Has the orb recorded them?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Mylva at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Spiritual Training: Mercy is for the Weak
quests.objectives: Defeat 5 failed supplicants in the cults lethal promotion trial.
quests.description: The cult calls hesitation weakness. Defeat five Failed Supplicants north of the training camp while maintaining your disguise. Ortell needs you to reach the graduation platform; the price of this cover will stay with you.
quests.completion: Their ordeal is over. You have seen what failure means in this camp. Remember it.
quests.request_text: Have you ended the suffering of five failed supplicants?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Mylva at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Walking the Dog
quests.objectives: Use the Fiery Leash to summon the hound, then feed it 5 pieces of meat looted from Spinescale Basilisks.
quests.description: Use the leash to bring out the Spawn of Smolderos. Take him to the basilisk hollow northwest of the proving fields, kill basilisks and loot their meat. Speak to your hound to feed him one piece at a time. Five meals will be enough. You can summon him again anywhere in the Vale after an interruption; his completed meals remain recorded.
quests.completion: It knows your scent now. Trust grows from care repeated, not from a leash pulled harder.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Devoran at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: A Champion's Collar
quests.objectives: Defeat the Spinescale Matriarch and bring its spiked hide to Devoran to make the hounds collar.
quests.description: Devoran wants a spiked hide from the Spinescale Matriarch east of his station. Defeat the matriarch and bring him the hide. He will prepare a collar for your supervised match.
quests.completion: A sound hide. I can make a collar that will hold when your hound lunges.
quests.request_text: Have you taken the matriarch's hide?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Devoran at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Grudge Match
quests.objectives: Defeat Butcher with your collared hound, then defeat Gromm'ko with the hound nearby.
quests.description: Use the leash or ask Devoran to prepare your collar and supervised match. Take your hound to station A and command it to attack Gromm'ko's raptor Butcher. When the raptor falls, Gromm'ko turns on you. Defeat him while your hound is alive and nearby. You may fight beside it.
quests.completion: Butcher and Gromm'ko have had their lesson. Your hound followed its handler well.
quests.request_text: Was your hound victorious over both Butcher and his handler?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Devoran at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Gather the Intelligence
quests.objectives: Recover the Twilight Communique from the recruiting compound and the Battleplans from the ritual compound.
quests.description: I can keep contact from this outhouse while you are inside the cult. Recover the communique from the recruiting compound's dispatch chest and the battleplans from the ritual compound's guarded command cache. These are two separate sites. Bring both documents directly back here; the delivery is part of the quest hand-in, not a separate drop-box task.
quests.completion: These routes are more than troop movements. The cult is moving prisoners and relics under the same seal. We have very little time.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Return to Ortell at the Outhouse Hideout west of the training grounds.

quests.title: Seeds of Discord
quests.objectives: Distract Karr'gonn and kill Azennios at the eastern rendezvous; recover the sacrificial key.
quests.description: The intelligence identifies Azennios, the envoy meeting Karr'gonn at the eastern rendezvous. Speak to the ogre and send him away with a convincing order, then kill Azennios before he returns. Azennios carries the key to the commander's restraints. Bring it here. A key alone will not get Jarod through an armed ceremony: your remaining training will win the speaking slot and provide the distraction we need.
quests.completion: Azennios is gone, and Karr'gonn blames a false order. Their own suspicion has opened a path for us.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Return to Ortell at the Outhouse Hideout west of the training grounds.

quests.title: The Greater of Two Evils
quests.objectives: Use the ascendancy talisman to assume a fire-elemental form and defeat Garnoth.
quests.description: Garnoth waits at the Legion challenge ground on the eastern rim of the Vale. Use the talisman there to ascend. Your strike focus burns away five percent of his health with each blow; your shield focus holds off nearly all of his damage for ten seconds. Use the shield, keep striking, and defeat him before the ascendant form fades. Make room for both foci before using the talisman.
quests.completion: Garnoth has fallen. The borrowed flame served its purpose; do not let its power persuade you to keep it.
quests.request_text: Has Garnoth fallen to your borrowed flame?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Mylva at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Twilight Territory
quests.objectives: Defeat 10 Horrorguards at the northwestern trial ground while disguised.
quests.description: The Horrorguards gather in the northwestern ravine, away from the prisoner altar. Go there while disguised and challenge ten of them. A rival will appear as you approach the trial ground, followed by the next when you win. Return to that ground to resume after an interruption.
quests.completion: Ten demons defeated. You have earned the right to stand before the congregation.
quests.request_text: Ten Horrorguards. Have you completed the challenge?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Mylva at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Speech Writing for Dummies
quests.objectives: Kill Okrog as he leaves the ritual compound, then return to Ortell for the speech notes.
quests.description: Okrog is the scheduled speaker. He leaves the ritual compound along the southern watch road. Intercept him there and kill him, then return to this hideout. I will prepare the notes that let you take his place. Do not search a book or summon him from a marker: watch the road for the ogre.
quests.completion: Okrog will not be taking the podium. Here are your notes. Give the crowd what it expects while you look for Jarod.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Return to Ortell at the Outhouse Hideout west of the training grounds.

quests.title: Head of the Class
quests.objectives: Speak to Mylva at the training compound to claim the speaking slot.
quests.description: Okrog is gone and the instructions are ready. Report to Mylva at the training compound and claim your place at the initiation podium. Read the crowd carefully. The key is ready; the speech must draw the guards away from Jarod.
quests.completion: Ortell has prepared you. I will put your name before the congregation. Take your place at the podium.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Instructor Mylva at the Twilight recruiting compound.

quests.title: Graduation Speech
quests.objectives: Match 10 crowd moods with Inspire, Incite or Pander, then speak to Jarod at the altar.
quests.description: Use the Initiation Podium beside the prisoner altar. Speak to the crowd leader and choose the response matching its displayed mood ten times. You have ten seconds per response. Correct responses remain credited after a retry. Then speak to Jarod at the altar.
quests.completion: You kept their eyes on the podium. Now keep your voice down: the restraint guard carries the key. We move when you have it.
quests.request_text: You held their attention. Did you reach Jarod at the altar?
quests.return_text: Speak with Commander Jarod Shadowsong at the prisoner altar.

quests.title: Twilight Riot
quests.objectives: Use the sacrificial key to free Jarod, then accompany him to the expedition refuge.
quests.description: The speech has turned the crowd against its guards. Use the key we recovered from Azennios to release Jarod, then stay with him as he leaves the compound. He will hurry along the escape route. Deal with any trouble that reaches you, but do not stop to hunt more cultists. Ortell can replace the key after a failed attempt if you already deposited Azennios's key.
quests.completion: Jarod is here, alive. Let the cult shout at an empty altar. We can finally follow the people who paid for all this.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Elementalist Ortell at the expedition refuge.

quests.title: The Buyers Behind the Banner
quests.objectives: Return to the quiet camp cache and recover the relic buyers' ledger.
quests.description: The recovered plans mention a buyer ledger at Azennios's eastern meeting post. Jarod is safe at the expedition refuge. Return to that separate post, recover the ledger from its correspondence chest, and bring it to Ortell at the refuge. There is no need to revisit the prisoner altar.
quests.completion: These payments lead to excavations in Dustwallow. Jarod knows someone there who will listen. We will send you with his introduction.
quests.request_text: Does the cache still hold the buyers' ledger?
quests.return_text: Speak with Elementalist Ortell at the expedition refuge.

quests.title: A Letter Through the Marsh
quests.objectives: Deliver Jarod's introduction to Dezco at the neutral Dustwallow field camp.
quests.description: Jarod writes an introduction to Sunwalker Dezco. Deliver it to Dezco's neutral field camp beside the Tabetha road in Dustwallow Marsh. Travel on foot or use your usual routes. His expedition can help us follow the buyers. Keep the letter safe until you reach him.
quests.completion: Jarod is free? Then you have already done more than this letter can say. Rest a moment. My people have troubles of their own, and the buyers' trail passes through them.
quests.request_text: Jarod's seal is familiar. Have you brought his letter?
quests.return_text: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Dawnchaser field camp beside the Tabetha road in Dustwallow.
